operations.name: list_tasks
operations.title: List tasks
operations.description: List active tasks in one project you may read. Optionally filter by search text. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.description: Read one task by ID. Its project must be readable for you.

operations.title: Create a task
operations.description: Create one task in a project where you have create permission. Give an explicit project_id and title.
